name: World of ClaudeCraft v0.3.0 版本更新
summary: ## World of ClaudeCraft（克劳德争霸） v0.3.0
body:
版本 v0.3.0 发布，包含游戏底层架构迭代与前期核心系统打磨。

## World of ClaudeCraft（克劳德争霸） v0.3.0
This release is a major online-play update focused on social systems, moderation,
combat behavior, performance, and the first-pass release polish for the public game.
### Highlights
- 新增 friends, guilds, ignores, and realm-aware social systems.
- 新增 player reporting and admin moderation tools.
- 新增 right-click reporting from chat player names.
- 新增 a classic MMO-style threat system for tanking and deaggro.
- Polished the title screen, login flow, character creation, and character preview.
- 新增 hashed media caching for faster repeat loads.
